controls.failure: An edit lands outside the ticket's repo and declared paths.
controls.retirement_test: Retire when the engine refuses every out-of-scope write itself and the smoke shows no case only this hook catches.

controls.failure: A gh call publishes text that the privacy scan would refuse.
controls.retirement_test: Retire when every gh write goes through the engine's own text scan and the smoke shows no case only this hook catches.

controls.failure: A task is marked complete while the gate result for the current head is not PASS.
controls.retirement_test: Retire when completion is only reachable through the engine's gate verb and the smoke shows no case only this hook catches.

controls.failure: An interactive session starts and the event log never learns its id.
controls.retirement_test: Retire when the host hands the session id to the engine directly and the smoke shows no case only this hook covers.
